components.title: Site certificate issuing
components.description: cert-manager issuing site certificates from the site PKI.

control-implementations.description: What the site stack's rendered manifests show about certificate issuers.

implemented-requirements.description: The site stack renders no certificate issuer that uses ACME.

statements.description: No Issuer or ClusterIssuer in the site stack's releases, rendered offline from the hash-checked vendored charts with the CI site file, has an ACME configuration; the Let's Encrypt issuer that the Theia Cloud base chart can render is switched off, and the render test fails if any rendered issuer names ACME.
statements.remarks: Your organization supplies the certificate authority that issues the site's certificates.
